title: Pending operation and background recovery
guidance: A pending UI must remain escapable. Dismissal after dispatch keeps the operation running; it must not claim rollback. Preserve a reopen/check affordance, prevent duplicate submissions and expose bounded unknown-outcome recovery. Offline Start remains a pink action whose activation explains the connection requirement, without sending a write.
Use content-specific skeleton panels for initial reads. Pending mutation dialogs have one close X rather than duplicate identical Continue browsing; operations remain background-tracked and bounded.
Stop waiting is functional recovery and needs visible utility/outline prominence, not a low-priority quiet link.

decisions.title: Dismiss presentation, preserve the operation
decisions.reason: Close/Escape/outside never claim cancellation of a dispatched write. View progress reopens the same operation; no second confirm is exposed.

decisions.title: Bounded recovery and same-tab memory
decisions.reason: After12 seconds a stalled write becomes unknown, with an explicit status read. A local session journal preserves uncertainty or a confirmed result across leaving/Back/reload without replaying POST intent. Author scenario/reset clears the fictional journal.

decisions.title: Local handoff boundary
decisions.reason: The journal is browser session storage for fictional fixtures. It does not prove server cancellation, durable persistence or a real write continuing after document unload.

decisions.title: 1.8 destination scaffolds
decisions.reason: Initial task reads retain a summary and task/context footprint. Proof reads use the proof panel footprint. Review reads use left profile+ratings/right history and the loaded breakpoint; mobile preserves profile/rating/history order. Stop waiting stays in the initial content. Dispatched writes retain background progress/reconcile paths.

decisions.title: Visible recovery
decisions.reason: Stop waiting and progress controls use neutral utility. Dismissal does not cancel an already dispatched operation.

parameters.name: Timing
parameters.description: OPERATION_WAIT_MS=12000; Start slow notice6000; background presentation timers survive ordinary same-document re-render/closure.

parameters.name: Host state
parameters.description: Each state machine owns unknown/reconciliation guards. Common runtime owns presentation, stable timers, session journal and focus.
